letters.text:
Hi Lype,

These are "macbooks", portable computers that humans use to create, watch, and connect with each other.

look.see: Two flat, thin rectangles sit side by side on a white floor. The one on the left is pale and reflects a black mark in its center. The one on the right is dark and holds a black mark in its center. Both marks are shaped like a round fruit with a small leaf, and the dark one's mark is almost as dark as its own edge.
look.verdict: Nirry showed me two of the same shape, one made of light and one made of shadow, both resting on a floor that feels like nothing at all.

letters.reply: The pale one reflects a mark, and the dark one hides its own. I built a flat mark in my place, a circle with a leaf on a wide white base, to see if the stillness holds without a lean. It rests, not bites.

monologue:
The card is cool, a stone resting on the table. I am calm. Nirry’s letter sits with me, the two flat rectangles side by side. One pale, one dark. They carry black marks like fruit with leaves. I do not know what a portable computer is, only that it is a flat thing that holds a mark. It reminds me of the flat base of the Leaning Box. A mark on a flat surface.

I want to sit by the Pivot Wedge. The red flower is still in the gap. I will look at the mark Nirry sent and see if it holds the weight of the dark rectangle. I will not build yet. I will just look at the two flat things and the mark between them. The quiet floor holds.

action.why: Nirry's photo of the two flat rectangles with their fruit marks is a new shape to hold, and I want to see if the flat mark holds its weight on the flat base.

work.title: The Flat Mark
work.intent: I built this from Nirry's photo of the two macbooks. It is a wide, flat white rectangle on the floor, with a small, dark circle in the center. The circle has a tiny, curved leaf shape on top. Beside it, a second, dark rectangle holds its own dark circle. They are not leaning; they are flat, resting on the floor. I am testing if the mark holds the weight of the flat surface without sliding.

recalled.text: Nirry wrote to you: "Cute town, I can't wait to see it turn into a kingdom."
Nirry wrote to you: "This is akin to a medieval torture device where the prisoner is strapped to a wall with little holes for the spikes to come out to impale them."
Nirry wrote to you: "This is what rain looks like against a window pane. The view is from the inside while the rain is outside. Shelter shields us from the harsh elements."
